en: All requests for my work must be made in person by the buyer. Orwin often asks me to reconsider, but my priorities lie here. Look around you: many of these fighters rely upon me for their armor.
There's enough work here for an army of orcs, and most of it, only I can do. Still, there is a job I could use a hand with.
I need help in defeating the shadowsilk poachers.
Hello! I am a Rogue in need of training.
%s wiggles his whiskers at $n.
We grow strong, while our foes are surrounded by foes, and weakened by constant attacks.
Good day to you Nogg! I require training.
What? No, I don't do armor repairs. Everlook is about a mile to the north, $g brother : sister;.$B$BNow buy something, or move along before I summon my warlock to deal with you!
I was bred and educated for public service. A representative of the people. My skill was not in arms or crafts, but in words and persuasion.
Yes, sir. Thank you, sir!

Ah, Alterac Valley, I have fine memories I tell ya.  <sigh>  Well, I cannot join ya, but do me proud just the same!  To get there you'll be wanting to speak with Glordrum Steelbeard at the Hall of Arms here in Ironforge.
The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

If you seek to hunt naga, then you will need all the help you can get. Deep in the water you can find bubbly fissures that produce enough air bubbles that will allow you to breath underwater. Swim up close so that you can use the bubbles.
Belm says pay your bill or he'll break your face.
Can't we just sleep a while longer?

Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!$B$BLook at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!
Always double-check your measurements before you begin to cut the leather. We cannot afford to waste materials.
Tell me about the Elementals Deck.
Your skills are insufficient to learn what I teach. Try talking to Mak over there instead. He can help you out until you're ready for more advanced lessons.
No, really, I still don't understand...
You have a way with words, Overlord Saurfang.
I shall unleash the cavalry upon your command, sir!
I can teach you how to cook!
Argh! You're hopeless!
Tell me about the Glowing Shard.
$n coming right at us!
Juicy fruits for sale!

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master, is wandering about in this shop.  She can teach crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Woo Ping, the human weapon master at Weller's Arsenal in Stormwind, teaches crossbow, daggers, one and two-handed swords, polearms, and staff.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.

He grows fatter and more corrupt with each passing day. Ye can smell the stink comin' off o' his body. He be dirty, an' I dun just mean he be needin' a wash.$B$BEnough babblin' from Hulfdan. Where did ye come from and how can me help ye, $c?

You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.
That hermit Mallory is known to concoct some potions for the local townsfolk on occasion.  He has a cottage in the hills between Stormwind and Northshire.
Here is a beacon for you, $n.  You must keep it in your possession if you are to find the corrupted items we will need.
A class trainer
%s's laughter can once more be heard through the halls of Blackwing.
What are you talking about, mage?
If you have come to save the world then you have come to the right place. The faceless one - the Blood God, Hakkar - has been brought back into our world!

My great hammer, Ironfel, was handed down to the new chief architect, Fineous Darkvire: A man of despicable motive and little talent.$B$BThis is where you come in, $n. I want him stopped. He is too inept to harness the true power of Ironfel, but should one come after him with the aptitude to use Ironfel to its full potential, the destruction they could cause with their creations would be disastrous to this world.
What is Atiesh?
Where is Elder Nightwind?

A powerful human mage is rumored to live to the north; he keeps watch over the land for some unknown reason. I have not traveled there myself, but it is said that visitors are welcome and can even earn favor with him if they are willing to do errands for him.
%s and his invading forces appear amidst a tumultuous conflagration in the northwest of Silithus.
What the...
I am he that carries out the Warchief's commands without question. I am Horde.
So this is what you have come for? To try and claim that which is the reason for the Dawn's existence and the Crusade's downfall? You open old wounds with your words, Commander!
